parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Molybdenum, $\text{Mo}$, forms an octahedral complex consisting of one Mo atom surrounded by carbon monoxide, $\text{CO}$, molecules. $\text{CO}$ is a monodentate ligand. Iron forms an octahedral complex consisting of one $\text{Fe}^{3+}$ and a number of cyanide, $\text{CN}^{-}$, ions. $\text{CN}^{-}$ is a monodentate ligand.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
(b)
parts.text: An excess of aqueous ammonia is added to dilute copper(II) sulfate solution. A dark blue complex, $[\text{Cu}(\text{NH}_3)_4(\text{H}_2\text{O})_2]^{2+}$, is formed.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Write an ionic equation for this reaction.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Explain the origin of colour in copper(II) complexes.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: An excess of concentrated hydrochloric acid is added to the dark blue solution of $[\text{Cu}(\text{NH}_3)_4(\text{H}_2\text{O})_2]^{2+}$. A new complex, **Z**, is formed. The colour of the solution changes.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Write an equation for the formation of **Z** from the solution of $[\text{Cu}(\text{NH}_3)_4(\text{H}_2\text{O})_2]^{2+}$. Include the formula and charge of **Z**.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Name the type of reaction when **Z** forms from $[\text{Cu}(\text{NH}_3)_4(\text{H}_2\text{O})_2]^{2+}$.

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text: State the colour of a solution of **Z**.

parts.label: (c)(v)
parts.text: Explain why the colour of a solution of $[\text{Cu}(\text{NH}_3)_4(\text{H}_2\text{O})_2]^{2+}$ is different from the colour of a solution of **Z**. You should refer to the energies of the orbitals involved in your answer.
